refnamediv.refpurpose: Return the content of a cURL handle if CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER is set

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.returnvalues;
If CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER is set, returns the content of the handle as a string, an empty string if the handle has not been executed yet, had an empty body, or a curl_exec call on it failed. Otherwise, including when a CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION or CURLOPT_FILE callback is set instead, returns &null;.
If a multi transfer fails partway through (a connection reset, CURLE_PARTIAL_FILE, ...), this function still returns the bytes received so far with no indication that the transfer did not complete; check the result entry from curl_multi_info_read or curl_errno to tell a partial transfer from a complete one.
If CURLOPT_HEADER is set, the returned string includes the response headers ahead of the body, the same as curl_exec does.
The content is not cleared by curl_multi_remove_handle, curl_multi_close, curl_close or curl_reset: it stays readable until the handle is executed again, so calling this function after any of those still returns the previous transfer's content.
